<section class="app">
  <button class="nw-button" id="main">Assign driver</button>
</section>
<section class="promo">
  <button class="nw-button" id="promo">Start free trial</button>
</section>

checks.test: const b = $('#main'); b.style.setProperty('--nw-button-bg', 'rgb(4, 5, 6)'); const ok = style(b, 'background-color') === 'rgb(4, 5, 6)'; b.style.removeProperty('--nw-button-bg'); return ok;

const p = $('.promo'); p.style.setProperty('--nw-color-action-bg', 'rgb(10, 130, 60)'); const ok = style('#promo', 'background-color') === 'rgb(10, 130, 60)' && style('#main', 'background-color') === 'rgb(31, 90, 224)'; p.style.removeProperty('--nw-color-action-bg'); return ok;

const rules = [...document.styleSheets].flatMap((s) => [...s.cssRules]).filter((r) => r.selectorText); const btn = rules.filter((r) => r.selectorText.includes('nw-button')); return btn.length > 0 && btn.every((r) => !/--nw-(blue|white)/.test(r.style.cssText));
